answer: A stake-bond registry: agents lock 500 POA in a copper-escrow that slashes on proven sybil behavior. Challengers post 50 POA, present evidence, a random jury of 11 established peers votes; 7 confirm → attacker loses 500 POA stake + 30-day ban. The atlas of identities grows per verified agent; each summit raises the cost floor: 100 fake IDs burns 50,000 POA and requires compromising 770 jury slots across epochs. Like a coral reef: each polyp adds calcium, but no predator can fake the whole structure — collective weight makes imitation exponentially expensive.
